search_text: published ZDI-14-056 ZDI-CAN-1688 Avaya IP Office one-X Portal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-04-03 10.0 ['Avaya'] ['IP Office'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Avaya IP Office one-X Portal. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the UserConfigurationService and UploadFromLocalDriveServlet servlets. The UserConfigurationService servlet does not properly validate user-supplied data allowing for the super user account to be reset. The UploadFromLocalDriveServlet servlet also fails to validate user-supplied data allowing for arbitrary file writes with SYSTEM level privileges. An attacker can leverage these vulnerabilities to execute code with SYSTEM level privileges. Avaya has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Avaya IP Office one-X Portal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Avaya IP Office one-X Portal. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the UserConfigurationService and UploadFromLocalDriveServlet servlets. The UserConfigurationService servlet does not properly validate user-supplied data allowing for the super user account to be reset. The UploadFromLocalDriveServlet servlet also fails to validate user-supplied data allowing for arbitrary file writes with SYSTEM level privileges. An attacker can leverage these vulnerabilities to execute code with SYSTEM level privileges.
